set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Supported Scala, JDK, Node, Chromium, operating-system, and architecture ranges are explicit.
- JDK 21 ARM64 and x86-64 are release evidence lanes; newer JDKs remain diagnostic unless promoted.
- M1, M2, RC1, RC2, and final purposes are documented.
- RC1 and later prohibit new modules, dtypes, and speculative APIs.
- RC2 permits blocker fixes only and reruns the full authoritative gate.
- Documentation, POMs, source jars, API jars, consumer receipts, and tag SHA are cross-checked before final.
set.title: Document and enforce the supported environment and RC policy
